game.name: Uefa Champions League 2006-2007 (Europe)(Fr,De)
game.desc: UEFA Champions League 2006-2007 is a sports game for Xbox 360 that offers everyone the chance to try their hand at football. The title builds on the foundations of FIFA 2006 by adding the exciting challenge of the Champions League. However, the rest of the leagues are not missing and there are many other competitions you can play in.
